_format: The five wards the file recognises. Each category has a dominant intent class (the kind of intent most of its intents belong to) and a 'fit' approach (the card whose category-key matches). Playing the fit approach to a matching patient yields Insight; playing it to a mismatched patient hurts.

mourner.name: Mourner
mourner.label: lost something specific
mourner.voice: Patient is grieving something with a name. They will ~~try~~ tell you. The file is built by listening.
tells: they say a name without prompting
they correct staff on a date
they ask after someone not on file

visitor.name: Visitor
visitor.label: came back wrong
visitor.voice: Patient is not where they should be. They are trying to wear the room. The file is built by ~~mimicking~~ mirroring.
tells: they ask after themselves in the third person

tenant.name: Tenant
tenant.label: brought something with them
tenant.voice: Patient is hosting a thing the file does not name. !!It does not want to be filed.!! The file is built by restraining.
tells: they flinch at the wrong moments
the wound is older than admission
they speak in a different rhythm sometimes

witness.name: Witness
witness.label: saw something
witness.voice: Patient has seen a room you have not. They will not tell. The file is built by ~~waiting~~ sitting with them.
tells: they will not look at the corner
they answer questions you have not asked
they have been still longer than is recorded

stranger.name: Stranger
stranger.label: the file does not yet know
stranger.voice: Patient is ~~not yet~~ between categories. They may settle. The file is built by ~~guessing~~ matching.
